SELECT e.id AS examination_id, e.medical_record_id, mr.appointment_id, pt.id AS patient_id, pt.name AS patient_name, e.item_name, e.status, er.id AS report_id, er.result, er.remark, e.create_time FROM examination e INNER JOIN medical_record mr ON mr.id = e.medical_record_id INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = mr.doctor_id INNER JOIN patient pt ON pt.id = mr.patient_id LEFT JOIN examination_report er ON er.examination_id = e.id
ORDER BY e.create_time DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT e.id AS examination_id, e.medical_record_id, e.item_name, e.status, er.id AS report_id, er.result, er.remark, d.name AS doctor_name, dep.name AS department, e.create_time FROM examination e INNER JOIN medical_record mr ON mr.id = e.medical_record_id INNER JOIN patient pt ON pt.id = mr.patient_id INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = mr.doctor_id INNER JOIN department dep ON dep.id = d.department_id LEFT JOIN examination_report er ON er.examination_id = e.id WHERE pt.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.create_time DESC, e.id DESC
